title: CDN cache purge caused origin server overload
root_cause: Accidental full CDN cache purge triggered a thundering herd of requests to origin servers, overwhelming capacity
resolution: Rate-limited origin requests. Implemented gradual cache warm-up procedure. Added cache purge confirmation gate for full purges.
similarity_reason: CDN-related incident, origin overload pattern, sudden traffic spike to backend
summary: A full CDN cache purge was accidentally triggered during a routine deployment, causing all cached content to be re-requested from origin servers simultaneously. Origin servers hit 100% CPU and began returning 502 errors. Resolved by rate-limiting requests and implementing gradual cache warm-up.
